name: Tour guide and tour operator

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.staff: Mara and Tomas (guides) and the meeting-point desk
A.customer: Alex M. (a visitor) · other guests · a school's teacher

services.name: Old Town walking tour
services.story: The main story: two adult seats on Saturday's 10am Old Town walking tour, $35 each, paid in full when booking. A tour the guest cancels in time gets a full refund; the price may be kept only with Sam's yes.

services.name: Private walking tour
services.story: A private walking tour for a group: a 25% deposit when booking, and the rest is charged to the saved card when the guide texts DONE at the end.

services.name: Free walking tour
services.story: The free walking tour: nothing taken, and guests tip the guide in cash if they wish.

services.name: School group walking tour (20 students)
services.story: A school group: nothing before, and one bill to the school after the tour.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Mara and Hugo (guides who meet at hotels and piers) and Lena (licensed driver)
B.customer: Alex M. (books for the group) · guests

services.name: Private van tour with hotel pick-up
services.story: The main story: a private van tour for a family of 5 with hotel pick-up, $560 for up to 6 people, a 25% deposit when booking, and the rest charged to the saved card when the guide texts DONE.

services.name: Private shore excursion
services.story: A private shore excursion from the cruise pier, $620 for up to 6 people, paid in full when booking.

services.name: Custom multi-day itinerary
services.story: A custom multi-day itinerary quoted first from the group's answers, signed, then a 30% deposit, and the rest charged to the saved card at the end.

services_shape: class: seats on a tour departure at a set time from a meeting point, with a set number of seats and a smallest group to run; a private tour books a guide's time for one group, at a meeting point or picked up at the group's hotel, home or cruise pier (flow B)
questions_before_times: how many adults and children, and the children's ages (sets the price and the seats)
for a private tour: the group's size, and for a pick-up the kind of place (a hotel, a home or the cruise pier) and the area
for a shore excursion: the ship's name, the day in port and the all-aboard time
for the brewery walk: that everyone is 21 or older
for a school group: the number of students, their grade, and the number of chaperones
safety_stop: someone unwell right now: chest pain, fainting, trouble breathing, signs of heat stroke
first_steps: Entry tickets to sites on the route
license: if: no state licenses tour guiding itself; where the local rules license sightseeing guides, each guide holds that license; driven tours need the vehicle rules (a commercial driver's license with a passenger endorsement for larger vans, and the company's passenger-carrier authority, federal for trips that cross state lines); tours inside a park or on protected land need the land manager's permit
staff_skills: tour languages, the areas and parks each guide may lead, who may drive which van, food tours, brewery walks, school groups
messages_never: guests' health, mobility or allergy details, children's names and ages, ID or passport numbers: only on the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
